subject.title: feat(ios): show OpenClaw logo in notch

question: Should OpenClaw ship screenshot-only iOS notch branding via TopNotch's undocumented UIScreen KVC and a newly tagged unsigned fork once licensing is resolved, or require a public-API/no-new-dependency branding path?
rationale: The correctness issue has a concrete license/provenance fix, but accepting private UIKit behavior and a new shipped iOS dependency is a release/product ownership choice automation cannot safely make.

options.title: Resolve and approve
options.body: Require redistributable TopNotch license provenance, bundle the iOS license entry, run the current archive path, and record iOS/release-owner approval for the private-API tradeoff before merge.

options.title: Use public APIs
options.body: Replace the notch overlay with a branding path that avoids undocumented UIScreen introspection and the new dependency.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer or close the cosmetic notch branding if the release and dependency ownership cost is not worth carrying.

recommendation.title: Resolve and approve
recommendation.body: Require redistributable TopNotch license provenance, bundle the iOS license entry, run the current archive path, and record iOS/release-owner approval for the private-API tradeoff before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main evidence connects steipete to the iOS project, license resources, and scoped iOS policy that govern this merge decision.
